title: Halo pack manifest (pack.yaml), extension API 1.x
description: The manifest at a pack's root. Read with halo_harness.packs.manifest; the extension API it targets is halo_api (1.0 in Halo 3.2.0.0, 1.1 since 3.3.10.0). docs/EXTENSION_API.md is the reference.

bundle.description: A capability bundle: a pack with a resource claim (Halo 3.3.7.0 R5). Read with halo_harness.packs.manifest_bundle; docs/EXTENSION_API.md "Bundles" is the reference. The same object is pack.schema.json's $defs.bundle.

needs.description: Each role the bundle needs (chat, stt, tts, worker, verify, ...), with the models that can fill it, best first.

any_of.description: the models that can fill the role, best first

window.description: the window it runs at, in tokens

device.description: where it runs (gpu by default); cpu costs no VRAM

vision.description: the model must see images (its battery profile says vision: yes)

tools.description: the model must call tools (its battery profile says tools: yes)

runtime.description: ollama (a model Ollama serves) or voice (a speech model beside it); read from the name when left out

reservation.description: What the bundle holds for as long as it is on: the model stays loaded (keep_alive -1) and nothing else evicts it.

model.description: a model one of the needs lists, or a needs role (whichever of its any_of the verdict picks)

vram_gb.description: its memory on the card; computed from the weights and the window when left out

window.description: the window it is held at (the need's window by default)

host.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: where it is held: a paired host's name, an ollama.hosts name, or pool (the default host when left out)

min_free_gb.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: the GB that card keeps free for tasks beside the claim

routing.description: Where the other work goes while the bundle is on.

task_work.description: coder-or-cloud (the default): the coder when it fits beside the reservation, else a cloud model

never_evict.description: reserved (the default): nothing evicts the reserved model

escalation.description: off: no cloud rung while the bundle is on (offline-only)

latency_budget_ms.description: the round trip the bundle wants, said beside the verdict's expected latency

reservations.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: several reservations, one per host (a paired host, the pool, the default host); each is a reservation

model.description: a model one of the needs lists, or a needs role

vram_gb.description: its memory on the card; computed when left out

window.description: the window it is held at (the need's window by default)

host.description: a paired host's name, an ollama.hosts name, or pool (the default host when left out)

min_free_gb.description: the GB that card keeps free for tasks beside the claim

schedule.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: the hours the claims are held, the host's local clock; outside them the bundle claims nothing

priority.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: every reservation's default; when two claims collide the lower one is pre-empted and told

min_free_gb.description: 3.3.8.0 R4: the GB each card keeps free for tasks beside the claims

policy.description: A policy hook (Halo 3.3.10.0; its verdict decides the call since R2): read with halo_harness.packs.manifest_policy; docs/EXTENSION_API.md "Policy hooks" is the reference.

run.description: a command in the pack folder: ["${halo_python}", "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/policy/<name>.py"] (exec form, no shell), or one string split like a shell line

tools.description: the tool names it is asked about (a tool, mcp__<server>__<tool>, or *); left out: every tool

modes.description: contributes.modes ids it is armed in; left out: whatever the mode

impact.description: what the pack says its verdicts weigh (medium when left out); shown; no verdict reads it

on_error.description: the verdict for a late, malformed or missing answer (allow when left out)

redact.description: environment variable names whose values are taken out of the tool input before it leaves Halo

after.description: true: the policy is asked again after the call ran, with its result (pass, redact or drop)

theme.description: a theme name; accepted and ignored until 3.3.12.0

panel.description: A Studio panel a pack declares (3.2.0.0 R3); Studio's own components render it.

source.description: a file under the pack (markdown, table, bundle, artifact) or data:<path> in its data folder (table, artifact); latest (artifact: the newest run's)

schema.description: an artifact panel's schema: one of contributes.artifacts (3.2.0.0 R5)

capability.description: A worker capability the pack brings (3.2.0.0 R4): its name is one of the top-level capabilities; requires says what this host needs for it to be available.

description.description: a sentence; no path, no secret, no environment reference

tools.description: CLIs on PATH, MCP servers or craft apps

platform.description: linux, windows, darwin or a distro

models.description: a model ref or a capability tag (long-context, vision, tools ...)

grants.description: permissions of the pack this capability needs granted

fleet.description: What the pack brings to the fleet (3.2.0.0 R4): worker capabilities in the capabilities catalog, mission inspector lines, mission metadata.

source.description: a markdown or JSON file under the pack

metadata.description: what a mission started by this pack's lineup carries

studio.description: What the pack adds to Studio (3.2.0.0 R3): its own sections after Orchestra, panels in a core section, palette actions, a config form, its event lines and attention rows.

id.description: The pack's id and namespace: its folder name, the prefix of its bios and lineups (<id>--<name>), skills and commands (<id>:<name>) and MCP servers (plugin_<id>_<server>). No '--', no trailing '-'.

license.description: An SPDX id such as MIT.

halo_api.description: The extension API versions the pack works with (halo_harness.ext.API_VERSION).

halo.description: The Halo versions the pack works with (halo --version).

events.description: a kind (its schema: events/<kind>.json when the pack ships it) or {kind, schema} (3.2.0.0 R5)

workflows.description: workflow names (3.2.0.0 R2), each workflows/<name>.yaml when the pack ships it (workflow.schema.json, 3.2.0.0 R5)

policy.description: 3.3.10.0: policy hooks -- a command in the pack, started once when armed, whose allow, deny or ask decides each matching tool call (docs/EXTENSION_API.md "Policy hooks"); needs the hooks permission

modes.description: 3.3.10.0: the pack's runtime modes; mode.json names the one that is on, and turning it on arms the policies whose when.modes name it

settings.description: 3.2.0.0 R7: packs.settings.<id> keys this version renames, {old: new}; halo pack update applies them.

bundle.description: 3.3.7.0 R5: a capability bundle -- the pack's resource claim: needs, reservation, routing, latency_budget_ms (bundle.schema.json is the same object).
